question_text:
Describe the error in this Python function intended to print every reading exactly once.

def show_readings(readings):
    i=0
    while i < len(readings):
        value=readings[i]
        i+=1
        print(readings[i])
        i+=1
adaptation_rationale: Keeps duplicate-advance debugging reasoning using required Python list/index loop; legacyiteratorAPI removed.
solution: The index is advanced before printing, so it skips the value just stored and prints every second entry.; With an odd number of readings, the final print can index past the end and raise Index Error.
